summary: Both backend+frontend tested on public URL. Core gameplay join/inventory flows work, but admin auth hardening checks exposed critical gaps and an inventory toggle UX bug on mobile after Escape/button interaction.

critical.issue: Set-Cookie observed externally as SameSite=None; Partitioned (not SameSite=Strict as required).
Brute-force lockout behavior was inconsistent across runs and quickly persisted to valid-login denial (429). Could not reliably reset login_attempts due inaccessible DB URI in test runner.
Switch-back ammo persistence check failed: after returning to M4, ammo did not preserve prior per-slot amount in one real run (expected preserved, observed mismatch).

minor.issue: Origin/validation guards behaved correctly in tested cases (missing/wrong Origin 403, invalid payload 422).
Join forced default Glock18 and 10-slot inventory loaded correctly; equip to M134 worked in real session.

ui_bugs.issue: Reproduced toggle issue: after Escape, inventory state became inconsistent; immediate visibility stayed true, then HUD inventory button click flipped to hidden and did not reopen after wait.

integration_issues.issue: Valid password blocked by active lockout (429) during UI run, so dashboard/settings/bot controls/logout full UI path could not be completed in this iteration.

action_items: Investigate cookie policy at edge/proxy: admin cookies must remain Secure+HttpOnly+SameSite=Strict on public response.
Stabilize and verify admin lockout lifecycle (exact threshold/TTL/cleanup) and provide deterministic cleanup path for automated tests.
Fix mobile Escape + inventory button state race/toggle behavior in App keyboard/dialog interaction.
Recheck WS equip slot persistence for ammo/reserve across switch-away/switch-back under cooldown timing.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_auth.py sets SameSite='strict' in code, but external response showed SameSite=None; likely ingress/proxy cookie rewriting risk.
Login attempt key uses request.client.host; behind proxies this can create non-deterministic/contaminated lockout behavior for shared test traffic.
Escape handler in App.js and dialog-level Escape close appear to conflict, causing mobile inventory/settings state inconsistencies.

success_rate.backend: 29% (2 passed / 7 total, 1 skipped; lockout contamination affected admin suite)
success_rate.frontend: 65% (core start/lobby/join/gameplay/inventory passed; admin and mobile inventory-edge flow failed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin lockout was active at end of run (429 on valid login). Wait TTL expiry or clear login_attempts before rerunning admin UI/API checks. Mobile 390x844 bug repro is stable with HUD inventory button + Escape sequence. Desktop lobby had 6 skins, no weapon cards, game starts with Glock18, inventory shows 10 slots, M134 equip visible on HUD.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (mobile inventory): likely double Escape handling/state race between App-level keydown (window) and Dialog close flow. Repro: open inventory -> press Escape -> dialog visibility/state inconsistent -> HUD inventory click does not reopen as expected. RCA-2 (admin auth): cookie attributes are altered on external response path (SameSite=None+Partitioned seen), and lockout state persisted across attempts with no accessible cleanup route from runner, blocking deterministic auth regression flow.
